messages:
Ana: Pulled a quick prototype for the usage/billing screen — two options: a compact token rollup card per project vs an itemized invoice card with line-items. Thoughts? 
Devon: Nice — can you drop screenshots? trying to picture the density.
Ana: https://figma.redwood/xyz (mock) — top is rollup, bottom is itemized. Rollup gives a neat glance for PLG, itemized is better for chargeback.
Sasha: cc @devon @matt — engineering-wise the rollup is simpler for streaming and caching. Itemized requires more fetches for line details but not impossible.
Matt: User research: finance folks asked for one-click CSV / invoice download. Itemized makes that obvious. Rollup would need an affordance to expand into line-items.
Jordan: Data note: most orgs need both views. Our telemetry shows 65% of sessions toggle scopes (org vs project) — so toggle discoverability matters.
Devon: Question: where does the org/project toggle live? left rail or top-level scope chip? Top chip might be more discoverable but eats header real estate.
Ana: I prototyped both — top chip when space, left rail when compact. Concern: accessibility — ensure the toggle has clear aria-labels and keyboard focus order.
Sasha: Agree on aria. Also contrast: the current blue token-pill fails AA for small text. We should use 3:1 for non-text or 4.5:1 for text. (Accessibility nit)
Matt: For invoices: propose primary CTA be Download PDF, secondary is Export CSV. Placement: right-aligned near invoice title. 
Ana: Copy tweak proposal: "Download invoice" -> `aria-label="Download invoice PDF"` and visible text remains "Download". This keeps screen readers explicit.
Devon: UX question: for rollup cards, should we show token breakdown by denomination (input vs completion) or aggregate tokens? My vote: show aggregate + a small chevron to expand to breakdown.
Jordan: Metrics-wise aggregate reduces noise. Expandable breakdown clicks are rare but valuable for troubleshooting. Default collapsed is fine.
Sasha: Implementation note: if collapsed, we can lazy-load line items on expand. Simple API: GET /invoices/:id/lines.
Ana: UI nit: when expanded, highlight the most costly line with a subtle border and tooltip: "Highest cost driver". Also add an inline sparkline for trend.
Matt: +1. Also add a keyboard shortcut to toggle scope: `g then b` (go to billing) — silly but power users love it. :keyboard: 
Devon: Ok next steps: Ana to update Figma with top-chip and left-rail variations, Sasha to spec lazy-load endpoint, Jordan to draft telemetry events for expand/csv-download, Matt to finalize CTAs and copy, I'll sync with legal on invoice footer language.
Ana: Will update by EOD and drop new frames. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
